subject: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@northshorebank.com>
Cc: Northshore Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Hi Lydia,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the security/compliance gates to concrete delivery dates and owners so we can align internal reviews at Northshore and Redwood. Highlights:

- SOC 2: we will provide the evidence index (attestation copy + mapping to controls) for your InfoSec team to intake.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed CAIQ + supporting notes to be uploaded to the shared drive.
- DPA: we've attached our standard redline and marked the clauses where we expect a short negotiation window.
- Data retention: proposed default retention tiers (transaction logs: 7y, PII: 3y, analytics: 90d) — want to confirm Northshore's requirements and residency constraints.

Please review the MAP and confirm whether the target dates below are workable for Northshore so we can lock the pilot week. Proposed milestones:
- 2026-09-15: SOC2 evidence index upload (initial pass)
- 2026-09-17: CAIQ & CAIQ notes delivered
- 2026-09-20: DPA redline returned for signature routing
- Week of 2026-10-04: pilot week / go-no-go decision (dependent on signed DPA + evidence ingestion + test plan run)

Attachments: NSB_MAP_v0.3.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_index.csv, DPA_redline_v20260909.docx (redline)

If those dates work we’ll assign owners on our side and share a short acceptance checklist for ingestion and validation steps.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@northshorebank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Northshore Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Vanessa,

Thanks for the MAP and attachments — helpful start. A few quick asks from InfoSec and Procurement so we can keep to your timeline:

- DPA owner: Procurement wants to know who on Redwood will be the single point for the commercial DPA redline (we prefer a named contact).
- SOC 2 evidence: InfoSec needs confirmation you will provide the attestation PDF and a mapping CSV that ties each control to the exact artifact (e.g., audit report, config snapshot, policy doc). Can you confirm the format will be similar to your SOC2_evidence_index.csv?
- CAIQ: we will run the CAIQ through our automated intake (Tenable-based workflow). Please flag any controls you consider out-of-scope in the CAIQ notes.
- Data residency & retention: Northshore requires (a) transaction logs retained for 7 years, (b) production data residency in us-east-1 for regulated workloads. Is that supported by Redwood Private or Dedicated? If only hosted, we need confirmation of region controls and contractual guarantees.

Procurement note: we will aim to review the DPA redline within 3 business days of receiving your named owner, else we will queue it to legal (SLAs are tight).

If Redwood can confirm owners today, we’ll proceed with the intake and target a pilot decision in early October.

Lydia Cho
Head of Vendor Security
Northshore Bank

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Kimberly / Vivek — forwarding Northshore's ask. Please see required owners and proposed deadlines above. Quick proposals:

- Kimberly: owner for SOC 2 evidence intake + CAIQ clarifications. Deliverable: final SOC2_evidence_index.csv + CAIQ notes uploaded to shared drive by 2026-09-15 (kimberly to confirm any out-of-scope flags).
- Vivek: owner for DPA redline and KMS/region clarifications (I believe you can confirm support for us-east-1 and KMS integration for customer-managed keys). Target: 2026-09-20 return redline with named sig routing contact.
- Vanessa (me): own MAP cadence, acceptance checklist, and pilot readiness runbook.

Other notes: for data retention we can offer two tracks: Hosted with region guarantees (contractual residency + export controls) or Dedicated/Private for full tenancy and KMS control. We should confirm cost/timeline differences in the MAP so Procurement has visibility.

Can you both ack and I'll send a brief note back to Lydia with owners and updated MAP.

Thanks — V

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@northshorebank.com>, Northshore Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Hi Lydia — Kimberly here (Security Ops). Thanks for the clarity.

1) DPA owner: Vivek Kulkarni (CPO liaison) will be the Redwood point for DPA redline and signature routing.
2) SOC2 evidence: Attached is the initial SOC2_evidence_index.csv. This is an index mapping each control to an artifact type and location (we will upload artifacts to the shared folder and mark items as "Ready for Review" as they become available).
3) CAIQ: we'll include a short notes doc describing any CAIQ controls we mark as out-of-scope for the hosted offering.

Link to updated MAP and evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NsB-Shared-MAP
DocuSign DPA envelope for expedited review: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-dpa-nsb

We'd like a 1-week review buffer to allow for procurement/legal comments; if Northshore needs faster turnaround, let us know which clauses to prioritize.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_evidence_index.csv

From: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@northshorebank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Northshore Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Kimberly / Vanessa,

Received the SOC2 index and CAIQ notes — thank you. Procurement will triage the DPA redline and aim to return comments within 3 business days of the envelope receipt. Two items to flag for closure gating:

1) Production residency + KMS: Northshore requires proof that customer data for regulated workloads can be pinned to us-east-1 and that customer-managed KMS keys are supported for encryption at rest. Please confirm the exact deployment configuration (hosted w/region guarantee vs. Dedicated/Private) that satisfies this so we can sign off.
2) Data retention specifics: Northshore policy requires 7 years retention for transaction logs for audit/regulatory purposes. We need a short note confirming Redwood's retention tiers and whether an extended retention window is available as an add-on.

Assuming the above items are confirmed and DPA comments are addressed, we agree to target the pilot week of 2026-10-04 for a go/no-go decision (final signoff from Northshore Security + Procurement).

Lydia Cho
Head of Vendor Security
Northshore Bank

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@northshorebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure pathway MAP — SOC2 / SIG / DPA checkpoints & closure timeline

Thanks Lydia — quick confirmations and next steps from Redwood: 

- Residency & KMS: supported via two architecture options. Hosted (Redwood API) can guarantee deployment in us-east-1 with contractual residency language; for customer-managed keys and ultimate isolation we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private (we will include a short cost delta in the MAP addendum). Vivek will send a short architecture note by EOD (2026-09-16) with exact config options.
- Transaction log retention: Redwood supports retention tiering. Default: transaction logs 7 years (we can configure longer on request as an add-on). We will include the retention SLA and export procedures in the MAP.
- DPA: Vivek will be the named DPA owner and will route the envelope to our legal team for any comments; we will aim to return redline before 2026-09-20.

Next steps:
1) Vivek: architecture/KMS note + DPA owner confirmation (EOD 2026-09-16).
2) Kimberly: mark SOC2 artifacts as "Ready for Review" in the shared drive as they become available (target: initial upload complete 2026-09-15 — thank you).
3) Vanessa: I will update the MAP with the residency/KMS addendum and circulate a short acceptance checklist by 2026-09-17.

Once procurement returns the DPA and Security ingests the evidence we'll schedule a 30-minute pilot readiness call the week before 2026-10-04.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will follow up after Vivek's note.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
